name: navigation-centered-v1
title: Navigation Centered v1
description: Fixed 64px header with the links on the left, the brand centred and the CTAs on the right. Same styling as the other navigations (14px pill links with a grey hover fill, 36px pills, round hamburger). With overHero it starts transparent over a hero photo in light text with a thin divider, and becomes the standard bar on scroll.
